members.signature: public static Float2? WorldToScreen(Rect viewport, Float4x4 mvp, Float3 pos)

docs.summary: Project world point to screen via MVP.
docs.remarks: Old code used System.Numerics row-major: Vector4.Transform(vec, mvp) = vec * mvp. Prowl uses column-major: Float4x4.TransformPoint(vec, mvp) = mvp * vec. The MVP matrices are already built in column-major order (proj * view * model), so TransformPoint gives the correct clip-space result.
